items.t: Rivian Automotive, Inc. (RIVN) is Attracting Investor Attention: Here is What You Should Know
items.sum: Recently, Zacks.com users have been paying close attention to Rivian Automotive (RIVN). This makes it worthwhile to examine what the stock has in store.

items.t: Rivian Is Growing Nearly Twice as Fast as Ferrari, but Does That Make It a Better Stock to Buy for 2027?
items.sum: Two vastly different approaches to the automotive business reveal why investors may need to look beyond revenue growth when choosing between these stocks.

items.t: Rivian-Backed ALSO Hits Another Speed Bump, Pauses E-Bike Deliveries Over Software Issues Affecting Charging
items.sum: Rivian-backed ALSO pauses T-MB e-bike deliveries over software and charging issues, delaying both editions.

items.t: MEDIA ADVISORY: Rivian to Host Autonomy & AI Day on December 9
items.sum: PALO ALTO, Calif., November 18, 2026--On December 9, 2026, Rivian (NASDAQ: RIVN) will host its Autonomy & AI Day to showcase the progress the company is making on its technology roadmap. The event will be livestreamed on the Rivian YouTube channel.

items.t: Rivian: Margin Expansion Is Now A Major Catalyst For P/S Expansion
items.sum: Rivian Automotive offers a favorable risk profile at just 1.5x forward revenue, supported by expanding margins and an improving catalyst landscape. I rate RIVN stock as Buy.
